key_impacts: Private and government structures were terminally damaged and required demolition
Buildings were rendered uninhabitable due to earthquake damage
Overwhelming quantities of debris accumulated, requiring clearance and recycling
evidence_snippets: In the wake of the 2015 Nepal Earthquake, UNV established a Nepal Earthquake Taskforce
A building remains standing after the earthquake but is rendered uninhabitable; it needs to be safely demolished
Demolition of private and government structures terminally damaged by the earthquake
7.8-magnitude earthquake hit the Pacific Coast of Ecuador on 16 April 2016
UNV established an Ecuador Earthquake Taskforce to coordinate recovery
Fifty national and international UN Volunteers were deployed as frontline responders
